name: noderails-card-network
description: NodeRails WallCard · Wallet Card (crypto in familiar card form)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "{name}" -c "bgBlue,bgGreen,bgMagenta,bgCyan,bgYellow,bgWhite" -n api,signer,worker,web,dashboard,mobile "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:signer-host" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @noderails-card/web dev" "pnpm --filter @noderails-card/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @noderails-card/mobile dev:mac"
scripts.render:build:api: NODE_ENV=development pnpm install && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@noderails-card/api
scripts.render:build:worker: NODE_ENV=development pnpm install && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@noderails-card/worker
scripts.render:build:signer-host: NODE_ENV=development pnpm install && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@noderails-card/signer-host
scripts.render:build:stack: NODE_ENV=development pnpm install && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@noderails-card/api --filter=@noderails-card/signer-host --filter=@noderails-card/worker
scripts.start:prod:backend: concurrently -k -p "{name}" -c "bgBlue,bgGreen,bgMagenta" -n api,signer,worker "pnpm --filter @noderails-card/api run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @noderails-card/signer-host run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @noderails-card/worker run start:prod"
